craft.collapse: TWO COLLAPSES, BOTH COUNTED, NEITHER INTERNAL. The pool is NOT one sentence twelve times and NOT a camera with no speaker: seven speakers, seven attribution frames, 20/20 faces attributed, one real disagreement, sensory nouns above benchmark, and every mechanical scan clean (0 em dash, 0 digit, 0 semicolon, 0 {settlement}, no repeated opener trigram inside any variant). On every axis the selector measured it passes — and all five of its counts measure INSIDE the pool, which is where both of these hid. (A) THE NEGATION LANDING: 12 of 23 units land their final clause on a negation, 52% against the brief's one-third bar, and variant 3 is 6 of 8 (75%) — spine 'is nobody's reckoning', elders 'it has nothing', tavern 'it would say no', register 'is not spoken of', market 'never at the doors', gate 'nothing is said to it'. Seven distinct speakers on seven distinct subjects still read as one withheld gesture worn eight ways. Cure: re-land at least three of variant 3's six and one of variant 1's four on what IS done, keeping the landing noun and never by deleting a speaker. (B) CROSS-RUNG COLLAPSE AGAINST THE LANDED `Economic Survival: WEAK`: six units make a landed sibling rung's claim source for source — v2 muster 'as it hunts, with what it hunts with' is near-verbatim WEAK's v1 muster 'the ones it hunts with'; v1 gate 'whoever was nearest lifts the bar' is WEAK's v1 gate 'kept by the doors nearest it'; v1 elders' store under each household's own floor is WEAK's v3 stranger 'in its own cellar and under its own floor'; v3's elders-versus-drinking-house DISAGREE pair on who is passed over is WEAK's v1 elders-versus-tavern DISAGREE pair on whose turn it is; v3's spine is WEAK's spine 3; v2 register's 'digging' is WEAK's v1 register's 'digging'. The turn motif and 'the same houses / the same backs / the same doors' carry both pools. A game master generating a WEAK town and a CRITICAL town reads the same page twice. Cure: re-cut the muster and gate faces first (the two near-identities), then re-source or re-object the store-under-the-floor face and the v3 disagree pair, so a CRITICAL town delivers what CRITICAL fixes — that nothing can be bought at all — and not WEAK's quarrel about whose turn it was. NOT WRONG, so the curer does not cure the wrong thing: speaker count, attribution variety, stakes, pair kinds, openers, sensory rations and every mechanical scan are clean, and the pool is far better than the three shipped rows it replaces (which carried {settlement} twice, a compounding-crisis clause that is F4-10, and pay predicated on bodies unpaid by definition, V-09).
